facts.fact: La Nouvelle Tribune reports that ASIN announced on 13 November 2026 a new version of the service-public.bj portal that includes Yemi, an intelligent assistant guiding users step by step through their formalities.
La Nouvelle Tribune reports that since 1 November 2026 the criminal record certificate is issued automatically on the service-public.bj portal after sign-in with the NPI, for 1,900 FCFA.

BEN.note: No count of services or ministries on the portal stated, so nothing on ten or more services or a single gateway.
ASIN announces the portal but the article does not say who built or runs it.
